U7.basis: TI DBV0005A: five pins, 0.95 mm pitch, standard 1/2/3 left and 4/5 right numbering. Library copper 1.2 x 0.6 mm, row centers 2.5 mm. Different source symbol MPN is not a procurement replacement.

U8.basis: TI DCU0008A: 8 pins, 0.5 mm pitch, body 2.3 x 2.0 mm, lead span 3.1 mm. Library copper 0.85 x 0.3 mm, row centers 3.15 mm, standard counterclockwise numbering.

X1.basis: User XTAL-4P symbol links this footprint. ABM8 3.2 x 2.5 mm, pins 1/3 crystal and 2/4 case ground preserved; footprint top-view numbering 1 lower-left, 2 lower-right, 3 upper-right, 4 upper-left. Pad centers +/-1.05 and +/-0.85 mm, pads 1.3 x 1.2 mm; existing library land variant, not an exact copy of the manufacturer land example.

U2.basis: SchLib parameter MPN=DRV8316RRGFR and LCSC=C5218861; symbol record 45 ModelName points to the exact PcbLib footprint; no MPN substitution. TI RGF0040E checked: 40 perimeter lands, 0.5 mm pitch, 0.6 x 0.25 mm lands; row-center spans 4.8 and 6.8 mm; EP41 3.7 x 5.7 mm. Ground pin retained. Thermal vias and stencil design remain PCB tasks.

D1.basis: SchLib parameter MPN=SMBJ18A and LCSC=C151256; exact symbol model record links to C151256_DO-214AA. Exact SMBJ18A footprint, pads 2.5 x 2.3 mm; pad 1 cathode, pad 2 anode.

C29.basis: Exact Manufacturer_Part_Number parameter and exact record-45 ModelName/ModelDatafileEntity0 in the new native SchLib. Exact 35SVPF39M SchLib model link; E7 lands a=2.8, b=11.1, c=1.9 mm. Pin 1 positive, pin 2 negative.

U1.basis: Exact Manufacturer_Part_Number parameter and exact record-45 ModelName/ModelDatafileEntity0 in the new native SchLib. 48 pads and 0.5 mm pitch; numbering is a rotated equivalent of the ST top-view drawing. SW1.basis: Exact Manufacturer_Part_Number parameter and exact record-45 ModelName/ModelDatafileEntity0 in the new native SchLib. ALPS land dimensions match; 1/2 internally common, 3/4 internally common, same groups as existing NRST/GND schematic.

J5.basis: Exact Manufacturer_Part_Number parameter and exact record-45 ModelName/ModelDatafileEntity0 in the new native SchLib. All 10 signal lands and both hold-down lands match existing KiCad FH12 geometry after coordinate-origin conversion. Pads 11/12 are mechanical and remain without signal nets.

J6.basis: Exact Manufacturer_Part_Number parameter and exact record-45 ModelName/ModelDatafileEntity0 in the new native SchLib. All 10 signal lands and both hold-down lands match existing KiCad FH12 geometry after coordinate-origin conversion. Pads 11/12 are mechanical and remain without signal nets.

J7.basis: Exact Manufacturer_Part_Number parameter and exact record-45 ModelName/ModelDatafileEntity0 in the new native SchLib. Source holes 0.70 mm; derived finished holes 0.85 mm and lands 1.40 mm (annular ring 0.275 mm). Locations, numbers, pad shapes and body retained.

J4.basis: User approved generic 1x5 2.54 mm straight header. Original user HDR2.54-LI-5P: 5 numbered plated pads on 2.54 mm pitch. Project-only holes enlarged from 0.90 to 1.02 mm for common 0.64 mm square posts; 1.70 mm lands and pin 1 square marker retained.

notes: C27 matches explicit MPN in user SchLib. That symbol has an incorrect datasheet hyperlink; no parameters or symbol graphics are copied from it.

manufacturer_package_sources.basis: Dimensional reference for standard 0.64 mm square posts, not a required purchase brand.
